name: milvus
description_en: Milvus is a high-performance, cloud-native vector database built for scalable vector ANN search
readme_excerpt: What is Milvus? 🐦 Milvus is a high-performance vector database built for scale. It powers AI applications by efficiently organizing and searching vast amounts of unstructured data, such as text, images, and multi-modal information. 🧑‍💻 Written in Go and C++, Milvus implements hardware acceleration for CPU/GPU to achieve best-in-class vector search performance.
